purpose: Predeclared qualification requirements and targets. This freeze records no successful qualification run or production acceptance.

functionalMatrix.additionalRequirements: Q-01 through Q-12 in support/qualification/0.2.0-coverage.md remain required; the functional matrix alone is insufficient.
functionalMatrix.sourceChanges: Move plan-store alerting from lifecycle to certificates and PostgreSQL reference data from certificates to data-plane. Master CI run 37420035400 passed in 92m45s; its slowest lifecycle spent 20m02s on plan-store alerting before the upgrade fault window. Rebalance the existing nine suites without adding phases or scenarios. All 17 phases, 345 scenario/engine/family rows, supported minors and platforms, observation windows, and Q-01 through Q-12 targets remain unchanged. Revision 42 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.13.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 54 adds the data-plane scenario postgresql-extension-drift, which stores Ptah v0.14.0's feature category for a dropped PostgreSQL extension through a cluster; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 55 adds the phase configmap-sources to the schema-approvals suite: a schema and a migration sequence read from ConfigMaps with no registry, edits to a selected and an unselected key, snapshot retention, and a replaced snapshot the Pod refuses. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 57 adds the phase git-sources to the schema-approvals suite: a schema and a migration sequence read from Git over HTTPS and SSH, a branch that moves without and with a selected change, and a credential granted for another host. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 58 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.15.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 59 adds the scenarios git-schema-pinned, git-force-push and git-source-refused to the phase git-sources. Suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 60 moves the phases configmap-sources and git-sources from the schema-approvals suite to data-plane, because schema-approvals with both ran past the 90-minute job limit. No phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 61 adds the scenario git-source-policy to the phase git-sources and moves the phase reference-data-postgresql from data-plane to lifecycle, because data-plane came within two minutes of the 90-minute job limit. No phase, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 62 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.16.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 66 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.17.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 68 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.18.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes. Revision 71 adds the scenario configmap-unreadable-source to the phase configmap-sources and git-source-unreadable to git-sources. Revision 73 adds the data-plane scenario database-reachable-kind to the configmap-sources phase, which drives a PtahSchema and a PtahMigration to DatabaseReachable=False with reason AuthenticationFailed and back to True; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 74 adds the scenario oci-unreadable-schema to the phase dataplane. Revision 75 adds the scenario configmap-refused-statement to the phase configmap-sources. Revision 76 adds the data-plane scenario postgresql-login-visibility-drift, which runs drift detection under the login the databases page documents with a table another role created, and moves the line naming the Ptah build under test to the v0.22.0 release image; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 78 adds the scenario plan-stale-only-on-replacement to the phase schema-approvals. Revision 79 adds the scenario pod-configuration-error to the phase dataplane and pod-configuration-past-deadline to the phases migration-runtime-postgresql and migration-runtime-mysql. Revision 80 adds the scenario apply-asks-for-the-realm-lease to the phases migration-runtime-postgresql and migration-runtime-mysql. Revision 81 adds the scenario approval-target-login-change to the phase schema-approvals, which moves a schema to a second login after approval and after a finished Apply and ends each proof the way a person would; phases, suites, cells, platforms and targets are unchanged. Revision 82 splits the nine suites into fourteen, because on CI run 42372668755 data-plane passed the 90-minute job limit and three more suites came within five minutes of it: configmap-sources and git-sources move from data-plane to the new suite sources; the executor and runtime scenarios of schema-approvals move to the new phase schema-runtime in the suite of that name; migration-authority becomes migration-authority-postgresql and migration-authority-mysql; and the fault rows of migrations-postgresql and migrations-mysql move to the new phases migration-faults-postgresql and migration-faults-mysql, each in a suite of that name. Each new phase adds the scenarios that stand up what it reads: watches and watch-history-audit in schema-runtime, fault-artifact in each migration-faults phase. Cells move from 27 to 42 per platform; platforms, minors and targets are unchanged. Revision 84 changes only the line naming the Ptah build under test, now the v0.23.0 release image; no phase, scenario, cell, platform or target changes.

publishedPredecessors.disposition: v0.2.9 is the published predecessor of the next candidate. The upgrade from it is walked through both releases' guides by support/qualification/probes/fresh_install.py --upgrade-from on both platforms; the synthetic transition, refusal and recovery proofs remain required.
